firm_data.firm_description: Whitbeck Benedict & Smith LLP (formerly Rapport Meyers LLP) represents individuals, businesses, government entities, and community organizations throughout the Hudson Valley. Since 1936, the firm has maintained a diverse, sophisticated practice, assisting clients with transactions, litigation, and administrative proceedings.
notable_facts: The firm serves clients throughout the Hudson Valley.
The firm provides legal services for public entities, large corporate entities, and individuals.

email.subject: AI for Whitbeck Benedict & Smith LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Virginia,

Whitbeck Benedict & Smith has maintained a sophisticated practice since 1936, and your depth across real estate transactions, land use, and permitting work puts you in a position where precision and efficiency directly impact client outcomes.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Hudson Valley to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on transactions and compliance work.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
